title: Produktion, Personalisierung und versandfertige Bereitstellung von elektronischen Gesundheitskarten sowie von PIN-/PUK-Briefen
description: Gegenstand der Vergabe sind die für die beteiligten Krankenkassen jeweils erforderlichen Leistungen zur Produktion, Personalisierung, sicheren Datenverarbeitung, Konfektionierung und versandfertigen Bereitstellung elektronischer Gesundheitskarten (eGK) sowie zur Produktion und versandfertigen Bereitstellung der zugehörigen PIN-/PUK-Briefe. Die zu erbringenden Leistungen für die eGK beziehen sich zunächst auf eGK der Spezifikation eGK G2.1, umfassen aber auch die optionale rPVC-Ausführungsvariante sowie sämtliche während der Vertragslaufzeit von der einzelnen Krankenkasse freigegebenen physischen Nachfolgegenerationen der eGK. Die Leistungen für die versandfertige Bereitstellung der eGK umfassen zudem das von der jeweiligen Krankenkasse optional aktivierbare maschinelle Beifügen eines Hauptflyers zu den im jeweiligen technischen Produktionsauftrag entsprechend gekennzeichneten Kartenbegleitschreiben. Bei gesonderter Aktivierung kann zusätzlich genau ein kassenindividueller Zusatzflyer ausschließlich gemeinsam mit dem Hauptflyer beigefügt werden. Bei Beginn der Leistungserbringung ist der Hauptflyer der Organspendeflyer. Die Leistungen für die PIN-/PUK-Briefe umfassen – je nach konkretem Leistungsabruf der einzelnen Krankenkasse – auch die daten- und drucktechnische Umsetzung für die sichere Zustellung mittels Zustellident. Gesellschafter der IKK eGK-Beschaffung 2026 GbR sind die folgenden Krankenkassen: 1. BundesInnungskrankenkasse Gesundheit, kurz: BIG direkt gesund, Markgrafenstraße 22, 10117 Berlin; 2. IKK Brandenburg und Berlin, Ziolkowskistraße 6, 14480 Potsdam; 3. IKK gesund plus, Umfassungsstraße 85, 39124 Magdeburg; 4. IKK – Die Innovationskasse (IK), Überseeboulevard 5, 20457 Hamburg; 5. IKK classic, Tannenstraße 4b, 01099 Dresden; 6. IKK Südwest, Europaallee 3-4, 66113 Saarbrücken; 7. KNAPPSCHAFT, Knappschaftstraße 1, 44799 Bochum; 8. Sozialversicherung für Landwirtschaft, Forsten und Gartenbau (SVLFG), Weißensteinstraße 70-72, 34131 Kassel. Die beteiligten Krankenkassen sind jeweils Körperschaften des öffentlichen Rechts. Mit der Zuschlagserteilung kommen unmittelbar unbefristete Leistungsverträge zwischen dem Auftragnehmer und den einzelnen Krankenkassen zustande. Diese Verträge begründen fortlaufende Leistungs- und Vergütungspflichten im Sinne eines Dauerschuldverhältnisses. Die spätere Übermittlung der Daten für die einzelnen zu erstellenden Gesundheitskarten und PIN-/PUK-Briefe bestimmt lediglich Menge, Inhalt und Ausführungszeitpunkt der bereits vertraglich geschuldeten Leistungen. Hierbei handelt es sich nur um „Produktionsaufträge“ in einem technischen Sinne, die weder einen gesonderten Auftrag noch einen Einzelvertrag begründen. Die regelmäßige Produktion und die sonstige laufende Leistungserbringung beginnen am 01.08.2027. Für die ersten 48 Monate werden unverbindliche Kalkulations- und Wertungsmengen von 4.490.606 Standard-eGK G2.1, 1.924.545 rPVC-eGK G2.1, 3.812.299 PIN-/PUKBriefen, 381.230 Sendungen mit Zustellident, 6.415,151 Abrechnungseinheiten für die technische DV- und/oder UPOC-Freimachung zu je 1.000 Sendungen, 5.132.121 beigefügten Hauptflyern (für die Angebotswertung: Organspendeflyer) und 2.420.000 zusammen mit einem Hauptflyer beigefügten kassenindividuellen Zusatzflyern zugrunde gelegt. Diese Mengenangaben begründen im Rahmen des ausgeschriebenen Dauerschuldverhältnisses weder eine Mindestabnahmemenge noch eine vertragsbeendende Höchstmenge. Die bei Vertragsschluss vereinbarten Netto-Einheitspreise bleiben bis einschließlich 31.07.2031 unverändert. Ab dem 01.08.2031 werden die erfassten Einheitspreise im Abstand von jeweils 24 Monaten nach der vertraglich festgelegten Preisänderungsklausel angepasst. Für physische Nachfolgegenerationen der Gesundheitskarten gilt das hierfür gesondert geregelte Preisbildungs-, Prüf-, Nachweis- und Freigabeverfahren. Die Verträge haben kein festes Enddatum und bestehen bis zu einer wirksamen Kündigung fort. Eine ordentliche Kündigung ist erstmals zum 31.07.2031 und anschließend im Abstand von jeweils 24 Monaten möglich.

title: Udbud af medieydelser
description: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) udbyder en 2-årige rammeaftale vedrørende medieydelser. Aftalen indeholder mulighed for forlængelse i op til 2 år. Aftalen vil blive indgået af FMI, men alle enheder under Forsvarsministeriet, herunder alle divisioner af Forsvaret i Danmark, som er under Forsvarschefens kommando, samt Beredskabsstyrelsen er imidlertid berettigede til at benytte aftalen til indkøb på aftalens vilkår og betingelser. De primære brugere forventes at være Personelkommandoen samt Hjemmeværnskommandoen. Denne rammeaftale om medieydelser indeholder visse grænseflader med FMI’s rammeaftale om reklameydelser, hvorfor samarbejdet mellem leverandørerne på de to aftaler er af stor betydning for, at købers markedsføringsindsatser opnår maksimal effekt. Såfremt der opstår et overlap i de ydelser, som skal leveres i henhold til de to rammeaftaler, vil FMI indkøbe ydelserne i henhold til rammeaftalen om reklameydelser. Køberen har imidlertid ret til at købe tilsvarende tjenesteydelser fra andre leverandører. - Aftalen angår medieydelser, der skal understøtte attraktionsopgaven i forbindelse med rekrutteringen til Køber samt Købers øvrige behov for medierådgivning eller medieformidling. Aftalen vil således blive benyttet til strategisk medieplanlægning, udvikling og eksekvering af medieplaner samt indkøb af medieplads til rimelige priser inden for de fleste mediegrupper – såvel online som offline. Herunder har Køber behov for rådgivning indenfor SEM og SEO. Aftalen omfatter også evaluering og effektmåling af eksponeringer. Køber er en politisk styret organisation, som beskæftiger sig med politiske potentielt følsomme emner. Det stiller krav til leverandører og samarbejdspartnere i forhold til at evne at manøvrere i krydsfeltet mellem politisk styring og optimal løsning af attraktionsopgaven. - Aftalen angår medieydelser og inkluderer bl.a.: Ydelser af strategisk karakter, herunder rådgivning om og udvikling af den overordnede, samlende mediestrategi for mediekøb, herunder i forhold til mål og målgrupper, platforms- og kanalvalg og evaluering, samt afklaring af mål og delmål på kort og længere sigt under inddragelse af målgruppeundersøgelser, analyser mv. Ydelser af taktisk karakter, herunder medieformidling, research af medier, inddragelse af målgrupper og marked samt medieplanlægning. Ydelser af operationel karakter, herunder forhandlinger med medieudbydere om priser, rabatter, placeringer mv., samt booking af og indrykning af materialer på medieplatforme. Ydelser af operationel karakter omfatter endvidere gennemførelse af understøttende overvågning af priser, rabatter mv. i markedet. Selve medieindkøbet samt distribution af mediemateriale er at betragte som ydelser på det operationelle niveau. Leverandøren skal på tværs af de tre niveauer foretage projektstyring, herunder løbende kontakt til og samarbejde med Køber i forbindelse med udvikling og eksekvering af mediestrategi. Rammeaftalen indeholder en honorarmodel bestående af 3 elementer: Kampagnebaseret procentvederlag, timebaseret honorar og eksterne specialydelser. Honorarmodellen omfatter prisgarantier på mediepriserne. Der sker opfølgning herpå, hvorved de faktiske medieindkøbspriser sammenholdes med de garanterede mediepriser. Ved afvigelser fra de garanterede mediepriser pålægges leverandøren en bod. Se nærmere om honorarmodellen i Bilag 8, samt Bilag 2.1.1 og Bilag 2.1.2. - Se kravspecifikation (Bilag 1) til rammeaftalen for yderligere oplysninger.

title: Germany – Software-related services – E-Akte
description: Das Land Nordrhein-Westfalen, vertreten durch das Ministerium für Heimat, Kommunales, Bau und Digitalisierung des Landes Nordrhein-Westfalen (MHKBD), möchte für die E-Verwaltungsarbeit eine E-Akte sowie das damit einhergehende Veränderungsmanagement beschaffen. Perspektivisch arbeiten im Zielzustand ca. 250 Behörden - ca. 90.000 Anwendende - produktiv mit der E-Akte. Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist eine zukunftsfähige und effiziente E-Akte, die den aktuellen und zukünftigen Anforderungen der Landesverwaltung Nordrhein-Westfalen gerecht wird. Die E-Akte muss dazu beitragen, Arbeitsabläufe zu optimieren, die Zusammenarbeit zu verbessern und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften zur digitalen Aktenführung sicherzustellen. Derzeit nutzt das Land Nordrhein-Westfalen das E-Akte-System nscale mit dem Modul nscale eGov der Firma Ceyoniq Technology GmbH. Die Ausschreibung umfasst die Bereitstellung und Weiterentwicklung der notwendigen Software, die Implementierung und Integration in die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur sowie Supportleistungen (Third-Level-Support). Die Ausschreibung umfasst außerdem produktbezogene Leistungen zur Wissensvermittlung, Schulung und Einführungsunterstützung der E-Akte.

title: Denmark – Advertising and marketing services – Udbud af medieydelser
description: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) udbyder en 2-årige rammeaftale vedrørende medieydelser. Aftalen indeholder mulighed for forlængelse i op til 2 år. Aftalen vil blive indgået af FMI, men alle enheder under Forsvarsministeriet, herunder alle divisioner af Forsvaret i Danmark, som er under Forsvarschefens kommando, samt Beredskabsstyrelsen er imidlertid berettigede til at benytte aftalen til indkøb på aftalens vilkår og betingelser. De primære brugere forventes at være Personelkommandoen samt Hjemmeværnskommandoen. Denne rammeaftale om medieydelser indeholder visse grænseflader med FMI’s rammeaftale om reklameydelser, hvorfor samarbejdet mellem leverandørerne på de to aftaler er af stor betydning for, at købers markedsføringsindsatser opnår maksimal effekt. Såfremt der opstår et overlap i de ydelser, som skal leveres i henhold til de to rammeaftaler, vil FMI indkøbe ydelserne i henhold til rammeaftalen om reklameydelser. Køberen har imidlertid ret til at købe tilsvarende tjenesteydelser fra andre leverandører. - Aftalen angår medieydelser, der skal understøtte attraktionsopgaven i forbindelse med rekrutteringen til Køber samt Købers øvrige behov for medierådgivning eller medieformidling. Aftalen vil således blive benyttet til strategisk medieplanlægning, udvikling og eksekvering af medieplaner samt indkøb af medieplads til rimelige priser inden for de fleste mediegrupper – såvel online som offline. Herunder har Køber behov for rådgivning indenfor SEM og SEO. Aftalen omfatter også evaluering og effektmåling af eksponeringer. Køber er en politisk styret organisation, som beskæftiger sig med politiske potentielt følsomme emner. Det stiller krav til leverandører og samarbejdspartnere i forhold til at evne at manøvrere i krydsfeltet mellem politisk styring og optimal løsning af attraktionsopgaven. - Aftalen angår medieydelser og inkluderer bl.a.: Ydelser af strategisk karakter, herunder rådgivning om og udvikling af den overordnede, samlende mediestrategi for mediekøb, herunder i forhold til mål og målgrupper, platforms- og kanalvalg og evaluering, samt afklaring af mål og delmål på kort og længere sigt under inddragelse af målgruppeundersøgelser, analyser mv. Ydelser af taktisk karakter, herunder medieformidling, research af medier, inddragelse af målgrupper og marked samt medieplanlægning. Ydelser af operationel karakter, herunder forhandlinger med medieudbydere om priser, rabatter, placeringer mv., samt booking af og indrykning af materialer på medieplatforme. Ydelser af operationel karakter omfatter endvidere gennemførelse af understøttende overvågning af priser, rabatter mv. i markedet. Selve medieindkøbet samt distribution af mediemateriale er at betragte som ydelser på det operationelle niveau. Leverandøren skal på tværs af de tre niveauer foretage projektstyring, herunder løbende kontakt til og samarbejde med Køber i forbindelse med udvikling og eksekvering af mediestrategi. Rammeaftalen indeholder en honorarmodel bestående af 3 elementer: Kampagnebaseret procentvederlag, timebaseret honorar og eksterne specialydelser. Honorarmodellen omfatter prisgarantier på mediepriserne. Der sker opfølgning herpå, hvorved de faktiske medieindkøbspriser sammenholdes med de garanterede mediepriser. Ved afvigelser fra de garanterede mediepriser pålægges leverandøren en bod. Se nærmere om honorarmodellen i Bilag 8, samt Bilag 2.1.1 og Bilag 2.1.2. - Se kravspecifikation (Bilag 1) til rammeaftalen for yderligere oplysninger.

buyer: Avon and Wiltshire Mental Health Partnership NHS trust
title: CA18282 - Provision of 111-2 Service
description: This opportunity is being run under the Provider Selection Regime (PSR) regulations. The development of a specialist all age mental health response via 111 is a key ambition of the NHS England Long Term Plan (2021-2024), and the recovery plan for urgent and emergency care priority for 2023/24. This required all calls for support during mental health crisis to be made via 111 by the end of March 2024 and is referred to as 111-2. Avon and Wiltshire Mental Health Partnership NHS Trust (AWP) currently deliver this service in partnership with a system partner. AWP is seeking a provider to deliver an integrated model for the NHS 111 Mental Health Crisis Response Service (111 Option 2) for individuals experiencing a mental health crisis across both adult (18 years and over) and children and young people (under 18 years) pathways. The appointed provider will be solely responsible for the delivery of the call handling element of the 111 Option 2 pathway, including access, triage and call management. AWP will retain responsibility for all clinical assessment activity and associated clinical decision-making and outcomes. The provider must be able to operate within a matrix management model, whereby all partners maintain responsibility for their own governance arrangements, professional standards and areas of specialist expertise, while working collaboratively at both strategic and operational leadership levels to deliver a seamless, integrated and high-quality service. The service forms part of the NHS England requirement that callers contacting NHS 111 and selecting the mental health option are connected directly to a dedicated mental health response service available 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. The service will work collaboratively with urgent and emergency care pathways, crisis services, community mental health teams, acute hospitals, ambulance services, primary care and voluntary sector partners. Not registered: Visit https://suppliers.multiquote.com then register and quote CA18282 as the reason for registration. title: TD2340 - Framework for Highways Services
description: The Council is seeking to establish a multi-supplier Highways Framework Agreement to support the delivery of highway maintenance, improvement, construction, specialist services, materials supply, plant hire and associated activities across the highway network and related infrastructure. The Framework will provide a compliant and flexible route to market for planned and reactive works and services and will be divided into the following 11 lots: Lot 1 - Road Markings & High Friction Surfacing Lot 2 - Road Restraint Systems Lot 3 - Temporary Traffic Management Lot 4 - Traffic Signals Lot 5 - Multi-Disciplined Lot 6 - Carriageway Maintenance Lot 7 - Carriageway and Footway Surface Treatments Lot 8 - Hire of Equipment (with/without Operators) Lot 9 - Haulage with Driver Lot 10 - Supply of Asphalt Lot 11 - Highways Resource Support The Framework has an estimated core value of £72 million over its full term. In anticipation of Local Government Reorganisation (LGR), the Council reserves the right to vary the scope, value and volume of services procured through the Framework. Should additional requirements arise as a result of LGR, the total estimated Framework value may increase to a maximum of £108 million. The values attributed to individual lots are indicative only and do not represent any guarantee of expenditure. Actual spend may vary between lots depending on operational requirements, available funding and any changes arising from LGR. Call-off contracts may include highway maintenance works, specialist highway services, traffic management, supply of materials, plant and equipment hire, haulage services and resource support. Requirements may range from small-scale reactive works to larger planned maintenance and capital improvement schemes. Appointment to the Framework does not guarantee any minimum value or volume of work. Call-off contracts may be awarded by direct award and/or further competition in accordance with the Framework terms and procurement documents.

title: Four Year Framework Agreement for Main Building Contractors for New Build Housing with a possible one year extension
description: Link Group intends to enter into a Framework Agreement with a limited number of Building Contractors to provide construction services for a four year period with a possible one year extension. This may also include the provision of design and construction services. Link works in partnership with a number of subsidiary companies who will also be entitled to purchase works & services from the Framework Agreement. The subsidiaries of Link Group Ltd currently include, Link Living, C~urb 6 Ltd (C~urb), Horizon Housing Association Ltd, Larkfield Housing Association and West Highland Housing Association. Although it is possible that other organisations may join the Group, becoming subsidiary companies, during the term of the Framework Agreement, and may also wish to "call off" from the Framework. Link also works in partnership with several external organisations, refer to Section 1.1 of the Contract Notice for further detail, who will also be entitled to purchase services from the Framework Agreement. In addition, it is also intended that any Registered Social Landlord registered and operating in Scotland will be entitled to purchase works & services from the framework, subject to Link's prior agreement. There is no guarantee of any work. It is however, more than likely that individual commissions will be "called off" either by direct selection or by mini tendering, within the terms of the Framework Agreement, to identify the most economically advantageous tender. The Framework Agreement will mainly cover the provision of construction works & services for new build housing, however individual projects may also include rehabilitation of existing properties, office and commercial properties, extensions, community facilities and adaptations, and planned maintenance projects. The projects will range in size, tenure and type from mainstream housing to a variety of special needs projects. The tenure type will cover all affordable tenures, private rented and market sale. Applicants should have experience of projects within the social housing sector for projects between 5 and 500 units including flats, houses and retirement living projects with a mix of tenures. The location of projects will vary but in the main will be located in the Central Belt of Scotland, Argyll & Bute and Highland, however individual projects may be located in any part of Scotland. The total number of units in each of the geographical areas may vary and specific numbers cannot be guaranteed in any area or in total. Although individual projects cannot be guaranteed, Link will expect the successful contractors to deliver a high quality and value for money service.

title: Brodick Country Park Conservation Works
description: This tender comprises of two lots: Lot 1 â Stock Fence Replacement Replacement of defective sections of stock fencing within two fields in the Castle Parks are required to maintain secure livestock enclosures and support the continued use of conservation grazing as part of the management of the parkland grasslands. Grazing helps maintain the open character of the fields, manage vegetation structure, limit scrub encroachment and contribute to a varied grassland habitat, while retaining the historic pastoral character of the designed landscape. Works will include the replacement of damaged fence sections, posts, strainers, wire and associated fittings as required, with existing serviceable materials retained where appropriate. Lot 2 â Stem Injection Control for Rhododendron Ponticum Rhododendron (R. ponticum) is a highly invasive non-native species which has colonised semi-natural woodland throughout areas of Brodick Country Park. The plant was introduced to Brodick Castle Gardens as an ornamental species during Victorian times, when it was also planted in shelter belts and as game cover on the wider estate. Over time, R. ponticum has spread from these original plantings, infesting semi-natural woodland and threatening these areasâ biodiversity. There is concern that Phytophthora kernoviae (or P. ramorum, currently present on the island) may return to the grounds and threaten the health of native as well as horticultural trees and shrubs, emphasising the high importance of controlling rhododendron, one of its main host species, in the wider estate. This contract forms part of the National Trust for Scotlandâs ongoing programme to control and ultimately eradicate rhododendron (Rhododendron ponticum) from Brodick Country Park.

title: Four Year Framework Agreement for Main Building Contractors for New Build Housing with a possible one year extension
description: Link Group intends to enter into a Framework Agreement with a limited number of Building Contractors to provide construction services for a four year period with a possible one year extension. This may also include the provision of design and construction services. Link works in partnership with a number of subsidiary companies who will also be entitled to purchase works & services from the Framework Agreement. The subsidiaries of Link Group Ltd currently include, Link Living, C~urb 6 Ltd (C~urb), Horizon Housing Association Ltd, Larkfield Housing Association and West Highland Housing Association. Although it is possible that other organisations may join the Group, becoming subsidiary companies, during the term of the Framework Agreement, and may also wish to "call off" from the Framework. Link also works in partnership with several external organisations, refer to Section 1.1 of the Contract Notice for further detail, who will also be entitled to purchase services from the Framework Agreement. In addition, it is also intended that any Registered Social Landlord registered and operating in Scotland will be entitled to purchase works & services from the framework, subject to Link's prior agreement. There is no guarantee of any work. It is however, more than likely that individual commissions will be "called off" either by direct selection or by mini tendering, within the terms of the Framework Agreement, to identify the most economically advantageous tender. The Framework Agreement will mainly cover the provision of construction works & services for new build housing, however individual projects may also include rehabilitation of existing properties, office and commercial properties, extensions, community facilities and adaptations, and planned maintenance projects. The projects will range in size, tenure and type from mainstream housing to a variety of special needs projects. The tenure type will cover all affordable tenures, private rented and market sale. Applicants should have experience of projects within the social housing sector for projects between 5 and 500 units including flats, houses and retirement living projects with a mix of tenures. The location of projects will vary but in the main will be located in the Central Belt of Scotland, Argyll & Bute and Highland, however individual projects may be located in any part of Scotland. The total number of units in each of the geographical areas may vary and specific numbers cannot be guaranteed in any area or in total. Although individual projects cannot be guaranteed, Link will expect the successful contractors to deliver a high quality and value for money service.

title: Brodick Country Park Conservation Works
description: This tender comprises of two lots: Lot 1 â Stock Fence Replacement Replacement of defective sections of stock fencing within two fields in the Castle Parks are required to maintain secure livestock enclosures and support the continued use of conservation grazing as part of the management of the parkland grasslands. Grazing helps maintain the open character of the fields, manage vegetation structure, limit scrub encroachment and contribute to a varied grassland habitat, while retaining the historic pastoral character of the designed landscape. Works will include the replacement of damaged fence sections, posts, strainers, wire and associated fittings as required, with existing serviceable materials retained where appropriate. Lot 2 â Stem Injection Control for Rhododendron Ponticum Rhododendron (R. ponticum) is a highly invasive non-native species which has colonised semi-natural woodland throughout areas of Brodick Country Park. The plant was introduced to Brodick Castle Gardens as an ornamental species during Victorian times, when it was also planted in shelter belts and as game cover on the wider estate. Over time, R. ponticum has spread from these original plantings, infesting semi-natural woodland and threatening these areasâ biodiversity. There is concern that Phytophthora kernoviae (or P. ramorum, currently present on the island) may return to the grounds and threaten the health of native as well as horticultural trees and shrubs, emphasising the high importance of controlling rhododendron, one of its main host species, in the wider estate. This contract forms part of the National Trust for Scotlandâs ongoing programme to control and ultimately eradicate rhododendron (Rhododendron ponticum) from Brodick Country Park.
